node.statement: Sixteen-term comparison. Set U_jk=gamma_jk,n(X_jk) and V_lm=gamma_lm,n(Y_lm). Exact source corner multiplication gives (XY)_jm=sum_k X_jk Y_km. Summing the datum compatibility defect over the eight triples (j,k,m), then the def-compressed-corner ambient-versus-compressed defect over those eight compatible terms, costs at most K_1 e||X||||Y|| because ||X_jk||<=||X||, ||Y_km||<=||Y||. The datum norm bounds give ||U_jk||<=(1+rho)||X|| and ||V_lm||<=(1+rho)||Y||. Expanding gamma_n(X)gamma_n(Y)=sum_{j,k,l,m}U_jk V_lm, its eight k=l terms are exactly the compatible ambient terms just compared, while the eight k!=l terms have total norm at most 8K_inc e(1+rho)^2||X||||Y|| by the preceding child. Under rho<=e<=1/4 this is K_2 e||X||||Y||. The triangle inequality proves the asserted estimate with universal K_mult=K_1+K_2, uniformly in n.
